purpose: Standalone district-year analytical dataset of recent-HMIS maternal indicators reconstructed from cumulative annual HMIS raw files (district Total columns).
source: NHSRC HMIS portal cumulative annual releases (B.Cummulative UpTo_Mar files); 2024-2025 only where UpTo_Mar files were acquired
year_selection: annual cumulative UpTo_Mar file per state; partial cumulative months (2024-25) excluded
district_value: district Total column (Total = Public + Private = Urban + Rural; state = sum of districts)

ANC_First_Trimester_Pct.formula: 1.1.1 (ANC within 1st trimester) / 1.1 ((NEW) PW ANC registered) x 100

TT2_Booster_Pct.formula: (1.2.2 TT2/Td2 + 1.2.3 TT/Td Booster) / 1.1 ((NEW) PW ANC registered) x 100 - possible double-count for women given both doses

Severe_Anemia_Pct.formula: 1.4.3 (Hb<7 old schema / Hb<=7 new schema) / 1.4.2 (Hb<11) x 100 - definition changed across schema; recent-HMIS indicator only

Obstetric_Complications_Pct.formula: 5.1 (aggregate obstetric complications attended) / (home SBA + home non-SBA + institutional deliveries) x 100; available 2020-21 .. 2022-23 only

caveats.TT2_Booster_Pct: TT2 and booster sums may double-count women given both; preserved, not adjusted.
caveats.Severe_Anemia_Pct: Definition changed: threshold <7 (2020-23) to <=7 (2023-24+); Hb<11 terminology relabelled (7.1-10.9 g/dl). Recent-HMIS indicator only; not claimed as harmonized with Dataset 1/2.
caveats.Obstetric_Complications_Pct: Aggregate item 5.1 exists 2020-21..2022-23 only; schema break in 2023-24+ to HRP items. Left NaN for 2023-24 and 2024-25. Not replaced by event-count components.

excluded.Institutional_Delivery_Pct: Legacy denominator was ANC registrations (2.2/1.1), newer schema uses a different delivery structure; not constructed to avoid non-comparability.
excluded.PNC_48h_Pct: No comparable within-48-hour institutional PNC indicator across required years (6.1 home-only; 6.2 is 48h-14d; 2.2.1 meaning changed across eras).
excluded.partial_2024_25_months: apr..feb cumulative files available for 36 states but excluded from annual panel
excluded.fy_2025_26: files listed on portal but anonymous downloads returned HTTP 500; not downloaded, not included

rounding: percentages written to 4 decimals; computed from full integer counts; NaN = unavailable
